mapper.select: select code from vpn.user_invite where user_name=#{name}
select created_at from vpn.user_invite where user_name=#{name}
select user_name from vpn.user_invite where code=#{code} and created_at >= #{since}
mapper.delete: delete from vpn.invite_code_history where code=#{code} and issued_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into vpn.invite_code_history(code, user_name, issued_at) values(#{code}, #{name}, #{issuedAt})
mapper.delete: delete from vpn.user_invite where code=#{code} and user_name<>#{name}
mapper.insert: insert into vpn.user_invite(user_name, code, created_at) values(#{name}, #{code}, #{createdAt}) on duplicate key update code=values(code), created_at=values(created_at)
